name: imagination-engine
description: Radical idea generation that blocks the obvious answer instead of asking for a better one. Use when the user wants something genuinely strange — creature, world, premise, concept, story seed, mechanic, ritual, form of life — or says the ideas so far are generic, predictable, or 'AI-sounding'. Burns the model's twelve most likely answers into a ban list, deals a hash-seeded hand of distant domains and a reality rule to break, and gates the result on an eight-axis rubric before it is shown. Works in any language.
